game.title: Mirror's Edge Catalyst
game.blurb: First-person parkour action-adventure set in the city of Glass, from Electronic Arts DICE, released 2016-06-07. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Platformer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story

chapters.title: Dashes, Hacks and the Grid
chapters.summary: Dashes and their star ratings, gridNodes, billboard hacks and interventions, and Security Hubs.

chapters.title: Collectibles in Glass
chapters.summary: Secret bags, recordings and documents, gridLeaks and electronic parts.

chapters.title: Time Trials, Beat L.E.s and Echo

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1233570)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Mirror's_Edge_Catalyst
Fandom (mirrorsedge.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://mirrorsedge.fandom.com/wiki/Mirror's_Edge_Catalyst
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0; its categories also list "2008", which looks like a mistake). Only its "Table of Contents" (about 2,600 characters) exists; it links pages for each main and side mission (for example "Release", "Old Friends", "The Shard") and collectible lists, but none is created, so nothing was used. mirrorsedge.fandom.com answers the API, but its page has only about 10 linked pages (for example "Faith Connors (Mirror's Edge Catalyst)", "Kruger Security", "Celeste"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 16 of 49 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they are named like story beats and sit in the main story chapter. Six achievements ("Easy Runner" to "Belle of the Ball") have only a move sequence as their description and sit in the movement chapter. "Law-abiding citizen" ("A good Cascadian follows the rules") is unclear and sits there too. RAWG lists a playtime of only 3 hours, which looks low.
